title: Item tooltip lib
description: Simple utility for mod or modpack makers!
body:
Item Tooltip Lib is a library for Minecraft that allows you to add rich tooltips to items that are revealed when you press a specific key.


For developers to use, it is recommended to refer to the [documentation](https://docs.google.com/document/d/17Zrx-QfwX5zSnqpD4sA-dQrAdij2VgHmgm2l1_2VIJw/edit?usp=sharing)

**Can I use it for a mod/modpack?**
 - Yes, you can.
